source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Ranged attacks by the bearer's unit gain **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**, plus **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** if **Pyromancy Discipline** is among the unit's abilities. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER** model may take it.

effects.appliesTo: ranged attacks of the bearer's unit
ranged attacks of the bearer's unit

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Librarius Conclave Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
